verdict.rationale: Postmark works as a headless, API-only service. Every operation is a token-authenticated REST call, official SDKs exist across languages, and the docs provide a non-sending test token plus server sandbox mode, which fit automated pipelines. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI usage itself, so coverage of the story is partial. Missing for 10: an official CLI or documented CI/CD integration guide (e.g., GitHub Actions usage), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage beyond a community note about using plain curl.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: All API requests require authentication using the `X-Postmark-Server-Token` header with your Server API Token
For testing without actually sending emails, use `POSTMARK_API_TEST` as your token.
